question: Does Bright Data publish a first-party notice that dates the closure of the Mobile network to new accounts? A third-party market report reproduces a screenshot of a Bright Data documentation notice, but no archived Bright Data documentation or product page read for this check carries such wording, and the archive holds no copy of https://brightdata.com/proxy-types/mobile-proxies between 2026-03-28 and 2026-08-13.
why: the removal of Mobile from the public proxy listing is dated between 2026-04-12 and 2026-04-14 by archived first-party pages, but whether accounts that already hold a Mobile zone keep it, and whether new Mobile zones can still be created, rests on third-party reports
